settings.max_label_chars.label: Maximum label characters
settings.max_label_chars.description: Truncate workspace names to this many characters. Use 0 to show full names.
settings.hide_inactive.label: Hide inactive workspaces
settings.hide_inactive.description: Show only special workspaces that are currently visible on a monitor.
settings.capsule_radius.label: Capsule radius
settings.capsule_radius.description: Set the workspace capsule radius in logical pixels. Negative values use 0. Default: 8.
settings.capsule_padding.label: Capsule content padding
settings.capsule_padding.description: Set space around capsule content along the bar in logical pixels. Negative values use 0. Default: 5.
settings.capsule_min_width.label: Capsule minimum length
settings.capsule_min_width.description: Set minimum capsule length along the bar in logical pixels. Negative values use 0. Default: 35.
settings.active_style.label: Active workspace style
settings.active_style.description: Choose whether active workspaces use a primary fill or a primary ghost label.
settings.inactive_style.label: Inactive workspace style
settings.inactive_style.description: Choose whether inactive workspaces use a secondary fill or a ghost label.
